seo.title: Barbershop Business Rates 2026: Three Checks for Owners
seo.description: The 2026 business rates changes cut the multiplier for barbershops in England, yet some bills rose. What changed, why, and three checks worth making.

media.anchor: The lesson is narrow but important. The figure that tells you whether 2026 helped you
media.alt: Worked English business rates example: 2025/26 bill £8,982 after 40 percent relief; 2026/27 uncapped £11,760; capped under Supporting Small Business relief £10,329.30
media.caption: Hypothetical England barbershop at unchanged £30,000 rateable value; illustrative amounts, not a real property bill

Qualified RHL, 1p supplement and SSB relief assumptions as stated in text, not business rates advice.
